security_spec.violation_condition: In Linux KVM on RISC-V, a virtual interrupt is injected into a guest via mvip (through SBI call to M-mode firmware) without the corresponding enable bit in mvien being writable and set to 1; the hardware silently drops the mvip write per the WARL constraint, causing the injected virtual interrupt to be lost with no error indication to the kernel
security_spec.summary: mvip writes are silently dropped by hardware when the corresponding mvien bit is read-only zero (WARL constraint); KVM virtual interrupt injection via SBI must verify mvien configuration first, or guest interrupts are silently lost
